posts.text: The transition of sports fandom from loyalty and joy and community to monetization and commodification is a little heartbreaking to me. A signal of the broader commercialization of everything not nailed down in America.

Trump is destroying our nation’s health care system. Intentionally. Just for fun. 

New data shows that his cuts have caused a 21% decline in ACA signups. And of those that do sign up, another 20% can’t pay their premiums and lose coverage immediately. 

A disaster.

Video

In my new book, Crisis of the Common Good, I argue that Trump is a symptom of a deeper spiritual crisis in America. One in which we worship cults of profit and consumption and technology and credentialism that benefit a small handful of elites.

Video

In Crisis of the Common Good, I call out the need to rebuild institutions like churches and labor unions - the places where people find purpose and connection. 

I visited with local labor leaders at @IATSE today in Chicago to talk about the spiritual importance of unions.
Full house last night with @PoliticsProse in DC for the launch of Crisis of the Common Good. Thanks to @CapehartJ for moderating!

These days I’m at a loss for words. The new corruption scandal is just bananas. Trump has been using inside information to trade stocks and make millions. And the scale of the trading is just mind blowing. 

Here’s what we know.

The threat to “blow up” Oman, a U.S. ally and key intermediary in talks with Iran, is just one more sign of why this war has gone off the rails. 

They are in constant panic mode, making mistake after mistake.

And it gives the NCAA an antitrust exemption that no other industry gets just so they can keep underpaying the athletes. I talked this morning about my new book, Crisis of the Common Good, on @Morning_Joe. I explained how we need a public/private strategy to rebuild the institutions where people find purpose and community - like social clubs, churches, unions and parent organizations.

Video

On Sunday, I gave the commencement address at Wesleyan University in Middletown.

I spoke of the cult of efficiency, which speeds us up, addicts us to technology, robs us of in-person connection. I asked the graduates to be wary of a culture that prizes relentless optimization.

Video

6/ Now the Trump Administration is scrambling to turn away planes and pause visas, but so much damage has already been done. Their reckless cuts and policy choices left us unprepared for this Ebola outbreak – and likely whatever is coming next.

4/ Without the needed resources or personnel, Ebola circulated in the DRC for weeks undetected. Now the CDC director from Trump’s first term is warning this could become a ‘significant pandemic.’ tinyurl.com/4fec568u
